purpose: Development-only retrieval and evidence-readability diagnosis; not a new AgentMove paper reproduction
query_session: first validation session by retained_rank, one per fit/development user
query_target: last observed check-in of selected session; not read by split-freezing script
personal_long_history: own train sessions only, all events strictly before selected validation session start
population_history: other users' train sessions only; exclude reserve users entirely; session end and all contributing event times strictly before query cutoff
query_cutoff: time of penultimate observed check-in, computed only when materializing inputs
candidate_catalog: union of allowed personal and population history POIs; never add target
candidate_construction: round-robin in listed queue order, deduplicate, skip exhausted queues, at most96 distinct POIs
queue_ties: frequency descending then most recent supporting event descending then lexicographic raw POI ID; nearest uses distance ascending then raw POI ID
memory_support: personal visit counts versus population transition counts from last context POI; restrict both to fixed candidate list
memory_order: support count descending, latest supporting event descending, raw POI ID lexicographic
memory_overflow: remove lowest-ranked complete rows; fusion interleaves personal then population rows before trimming; never clip whole prompt tail
budget_interpretation: same upper bounds, not exactly matched realized tokens; report actual rows/tokens and unused quota; do not backfill empty fusion source
next_gate: CPU input/candidate builder plus independent time, target-isolation and source-exclusion checks, then reader prompt/decoder freeze before any generation

statistics.denominator: all frozen users including missing candidate or failed prediction
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over three planned Acc1 comparisons

reserve_policy: user IDs reserved only; no target selection, fitting, population-memory contribution, or prediction until a later frozen evaluation protocol
fit_development_policy: fit is pipeline-development data, not permission to train on labels later than evaluation queries; any learned predictor/router requires separately verified global training-label cutoff
limitations: Retrospective session-count eligibility; not prospective enrollment
Prior city preprocessing may have seen these histories
Shared candidates use both personal and population information, so reader condition differences isolate additional evidence only
Development diagnostics are not confirmatory tests of habitual drift
